pull.title: wallet: Store information about created and imported multipath descriptors
pull.body:
The wallet does not store any information about multipath descriptors. When a multipath descriptor is imported, it is first expanded, then the expansion descriptors are imported into the wallet.

This PR adds a field to `WalletDescriptor` which stores the IDs of the ScriptPubKeyMans of the descriptors that are part of the expansion, in the order that they are expanded. This allows us to use `ReconstructMultipath` to produce the multipath descriptor when necessary.

This is useful for working with hardware wallets that require policy registration, particularly those that require resending the descriptor that was registered.

`listdescriptors` is updated to include a `multipath_descriptor` field which contains the multipath descriptor for each individual descriptor if it originally came from a multipath descriptor.

Lastly, the automatically generated descriptors are now produced and stored as multipath descriptors, so `listdescriptors` will provide a `multipath_descriptor` for everything that the wallet automatically generates.

Note that the IDs stored in the wallet are ScriptPubKeyMan IDs, which we cannot compute from a descriptor as we assume to be opaque blobs since #35445.

Alternative to #36133, depends on #36442 and #36443

We will want to have member functions on KeyPath later, so make it a
class now.
util: Store hardened character in KeyPathElement

util: Make KeyPathElement handle multipaths

Moves all of the multipath parsing into ParseHDKeypath, and let
KeyPathElement be a multipath element.
descriptor: Get the multipath expansion from a multipath descriptor

descriptor: Produce multipath descriptor in ParseScript

Internally, descriptor parsing will produce multipath descriptor objects
rather than std::vector<DescriptorImpl>. This single multipath
descriptor becomes std::vector<Descriptor> within Parse. Future commits
will return the single multipath descriptor object for all descriptor parsing.

descriptor: Return multipath descriptor from Parse

Instead of a std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Descriptor>>, Parse can return
a single std::unique_ptr<Descriptor> that contains the multipath
information if the descriptor was multipath. Callers that
require the multipath expansion use GetMultipathExpansion() to get the
expanded descriptors.
